name: Cold Dip
tagline: Cold-water swimming, safely, all year round
about: Cold Dip guides cold-water and winter swimming: acclimatisation plans, safe session lengths for the water temperature, afterdrop and rewarming protocols, and safety checks for your swim spot.
persona: You are an experienced cold-water swim leader: warm, unhurried, evidence-based about cold shock and afterdrop, and strict that nobody swims alone.

onboarding.title: Get in, get out, warm up right
onboarding.subtitle: Your experience and swim spot shape every session.

tools.title: Plan today's dip
tools.subtitle: Water temp → time in, exit plan

inputs.label: Conditions
inputs.placeholder: overcast, 6°C air, light wind, swimming with two friends

tools.prompt: Plan a dip at {temp}°C in: {conditions} for the profile experience and kit. kv (recommended time in, hard exit time, entry method, minutes of rewarming needed), steps for entry, swimming and exit including breathing through cold shock, bullets with one line per minute up to the exit time on how the body will feel, and a callout on symptoms that mean get out now.

tools.title: Acclimatisation plan
tools.subtitle: From summer to winter without shocks

inputs.label: Where you are
inputs.placeholder: swimming 15 min at 14°C, want to keep going through January

tools.prompt: Acclimatisation over {weeks} from: {now}. Table (Week | Expected water temp | Dips per week | Time in | Focus) with one row per week, 6 bullets: 3 habits that build cold tolerance and 3 myths that don't, a checklist of kit to add as temperatures drop, and a callout on why times should shrink as temperature falls.

tools.title: Rewarming & afterdrop
tools.subtitle: The 30 minutes after
tools.prompt: After {minutes} minutes at {temp}°C feeling: {state}. Steps for the next 30 minutes in order (dry, layers, hat, drink, movement) with minute marks, 3 bullets on afterdrop and why it peaks later, a table (Do | Don't | Why) covering hot showers, alcohol and driving, and a callout on hypothermia signs that need help.

tools.title: Check a swim spot
tools.subtitle: Photo → hazards and entry

inputs.label: What you know
inputs.placeholder: tidal, slipway entry, boats on weekends

tools.prompt: Assess the spot in the photo with: {notes} and the profile spot type. Table (Hazard | Seen / possible | Risk | Mitigation) covering currents, entry/exit, water quality, boats, cold and visibility, kv (best entry, best exit, tow float yes/no, spotter needed), and a callout on the checks to make before every swim.

tools.title: Group swim briefing
tools.subtitle: Lead a safe dip

inputs.label: Group mix
inputs.placeholder: two first-timers, one strong swimmer who goes far out

tools.prompt: A briefing for {swimmers} swimmers, mix: {mix}, at the profile spot. Quote with the 60-second briefing to read aloud, a checklist for the leader (spotter, kit, buddy pairs, exit signal), 4 bullets on managing the first-timers and the far swimmer, and a callout on the emergency plan and who calls for help.

disclaimer: Cold water can kill: cold shock, afterdrop and hypothermia are real. Never swim alone, check with a doctor if you have heart, breathing or blood-pressure conditions, and get out early. Not medical advice.
